The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/ton/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in the Tongan language of Tonga, Revised West Version
> Public Domain
> Language: Tongan
> Translation by: James Baxley
> Cover and title page artist: Kitione Vailea
> Digital editions and layout: Michael Johnson
> Web site: https://ebible.org/ton/
> Translator support: https://worldoutreach.org/325
> 2025-10-25

What was found:
Text: the Revised West Version (2014), revised by James Baxley from Thomas West's Wesleyan text (London 1860-62).

Why it stays out: missing fact: a public-domain dedication in James Baxley's own words, and whether the Bible Society of the South Pacific holds rights in the Revised West Version.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=ton), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/ton/copyright.htm), https://worldoutreach.org/325; https://ebible.org/details.php?id=ton.
